trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Radiant Horn
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Radiant damage.

legendary.name: Charging Horn
entries: The unicorn moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52|Opportunity Attacks}, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

legendary.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

spellcasting.name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
headerEntries: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts {@spell Cure Wounds|SRD52} or {@spell Lesser Restoration|SRD52} on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: If the vampire drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition until it regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, and it regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} after spending 1 hour there.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weakness
entries: The vampire has these weaknesses:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

items.name: Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition in its resting place, the vampire has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition until the weapon is removed.

items.name: Sunlight
entries: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: The vampire makes two Grave Strike attacks and uses Bite.

action.name: Grave Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two hands.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52}, or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a {@creature Vampire Spawn|SRD52} under the vampire's control.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat ({@variantrule Speed|SRD52} 5 ft., {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist ({@variantrule Speed|SRD52} 5 ft., {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, are unchanged.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

legendary.name: Deathless Strike
entries: The vampire moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it makes one Grave Strike attack.

spellcasting.name: Charm {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell Charm Person|SRD52}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}), and the duration is 24 hours. The {@condition Charmed|SRD52} target is a willing recipient of the vampire's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was {@condition Charmed|SRD52} by the vampire.

spellcasting.name: Beguile
headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell Command|SRD52}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Necrotic Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Necrotic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a {@creature Zombie|SRD52} under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: The wisp can't wear or carry anything.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 20 feet.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Shock
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Lightning damage.

bonus.name: Consume Life
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 10}, one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. {@actSaveFail} The target dies, and the wisp regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

bonus.name: Vanish
entries: The wisp and its light have the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition until the wisp's {@status Concentration|SRD52} ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Cold Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wraith has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: The wraith targets a Humanoid corpse within 10 feet of itself that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute. The target's spirit rises as a {@creature Specter|SRD52} in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at a time.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The xorn can pinpoint the location of precious metals and stones within 60 feet of itself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xorn makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Charge
entries: The xorn moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} or {@variantrule Burrow Speed|SRD52} straight toward an enemy it can sense.
